news.title: Suez return speeds up Savannah India service by 10-14 days
news.summary: Two major liners are returning India-Savannah services to the Suez Canal, cutting transit times by up to 14 days. The post Suez return speeds up Savannah India service by 10-14 days appeared first on FreightWaves.

news.title: Puma opens U.S. distribution centers to third parties
news.summary: Puma has contracted with shipping giant Maersk to run its automated distribution centers in the U.S. with the proviso that unused space can be rented to other companies. The post Puma opens U.S. distribution centers to third parties appeared first on FreightWaves.
